ratings.note: probes/13 final.png: main holds only 'Booking stopped' and BK-409; any over-length/feet/LOA mismatch (occasional) blocks the critical journey with only a phone call as recovery; cause not stated so it can recur. s=4.
Boat form shows 'Length' with no unit beside 'Draught in metres'; skippers thinking in feet (occasional) enter 34 and hit the dead end; first-timers do not learn it. s=3.

MMSI has no hint and is required (errors screenshot); boats without DSC are blocked and must phone. s=4; rated 3 because most cruising yachts carry DSC and the true block affects few, others are only slowed looking it up.

Root screenshot: caption 'times in UTC' while arrival options carry no zone; every BST booking that plans from the table risks a one-hour error against a ~4 h gate window; returning skippers may learn it. s=3.
Berths 375 screenshot: lone '...' button below the summary; date changes are common for weather, the menu works when tried so the cost is search time or a 3-field restart; learnable. s=2.
Boat page names neither berth nor limit; matters mainly for boats near a limit (common), a memory load rather than an error in itself (the stop is rated separately). s=2.
Same dead end as probes/13: no cause, no link back, larger berth exists; occasional mismatch blocks booking or forces a call. s=4.
Error link targets a non-focusable fieldset; keyboard/screen-reader users who submit without a berth must find the radios themselves; minor detour each time. s=2.
Select and radios keep resting border in error state; error summary and red text still shown so the field is identifiable; only in error states. s=1.
Berth cards have no checked style but the native filled radio shows the choice; every booking sees it, effect trivial. s=1.
Out-of-range or past dates pass to berths and confirmation (probes/4); rare mis-entry via a date picker, but uncaught all the way to a wrong booking. s=2.
UTC caption vs zoneless arrival times and office hours during BST; planning from the table puts the arrival an hour off the gate window. s=3.

Cards say 'Boats up to 10 metres' without LOA/hull; boats with overhangs (occasional) pick a short berth and either hit the stop or are mis-booked; the harbour likely re-berths on arrival, so impact 2 not 3. s=3.
probes/13 final.png: dead end with no reason or route back; entries look lost; recovery only by phone or restart. s=4.
Any of 06:00-21:00 accepted though most hours fall outside the gate window (probes/2); newcomers not cross-checking the table book an unworkable time, found only at the sill. s=3.
2025-01-01 accepted (probes/4); rare mistyped year, but carried uncaught to a confirmation. s=2.
All berths listed before length is known; mismatch surfaces only after the boat form (probes/13); the loss itself is rated under the stop page, here the structural error trap. s=3.
Stop screen (probes/13, 15) gives no reason or fix; booking blocked, call or restart required. s=4.
'Length' unspecified; probes/19 shows hull length 9.6 accepted for a 10.4 m LOA boat on a 10 m berth; many yachts have overhangs; silent wrong booking. s=3.

Unexplained required MMSI ('Enter the MMSI' in errors screenshot); blocks boats without DSC. s=4; rated 3 because those without an MMSI are a small share of visiting yachts and most others can look it up.
5-digit MMSI accepted (probes/18); only on mistyping, and the office can still hail by boat name; no effect on the user's task. s=1.
Change dates only behind '...' (probes/24); a common need, the cost is discovery time or re-entering three fields; learnable. s=2.
Review has no change or back link (ARIA absence); skippers who spot a mistake must restart via header (losing entries) or confirm wrong details. s=3.
Header/menu links go to bare index.html, form returns empty (probes/24, 32); occasional mid-flow tide/rules check costs full re-entry on a phone. s=3.
Berth/pontoon space/mooring across pages; every booking sees it, momentary doubt, settled once the list is read. s=2.
Confirmation drops the arrival time; every booking, but the skipper chose the time and plans by the tide anyway. s=3; rated 2 as the omission rarely causes an error.
08:00 on 17 Oct accepted with no gate notice (probes/8); about 12 of 16 options are outside the window; consequence is waiting outside the sill. s=3.
Tide times link from review lands on an empty form (probes/23, 29); occasional mid-booking check loses all entries, no warning. s=3.

Table fixed to 17-23 Oct (probes/29) while the season runs to March; task 3 unsupported for nearly every other date. s=4; rated 3 because skippers know tides and routinely carry other tide sources, so the cost is a detour, not a block.
No step indicator on any of the four pages; every booking, orientation only, task completes. s=3; rated 2 because the flow is short and each page's single action makes position fairly clear.
Confirmation shows date without 15:00 (probes/1); every booking, recall burden only. s=3; rated 2 as the skipper's own chosen time is easily remembered and tide governs arrival anyway.
Header 'Book a berth'/'Tide times' reset the form (probes/30); occasional, full re-entry, no warning. s=3.
Boat and review pages have no back/change control; anyone revising an earlier step must rely on browser Back or restart. s=3.
'34 ft' gives 'Enter the length as a number' with no unit (probes/17); feet users may resubmit 34 and reach the stop; per occurrence. s=2.
Duplicate of short-MMSI acceptance (probes/17); rare typo, little user-facing effect. s=1.
Confirmation lacks time, boat and amount (probes/3); every booking, recall only. s=3; rated 2 because no wrong action follows from the omission.
Widowed words at 320/375 (berths screenshot 'space'); cosmetic, text still reads. s=1.
Root 1280 screenshot: left headers over right-aligned times; columns still unambiguous (morning/afternoon order obvious). s=1.
Only one fixed week of tides, nothing for other dates on any page; s=4; rated 3 because skippers have almanac/app tide data, so the cost is a detour rather than failure.
No progress element on four pages (probes/3); every booking, orientation only. s=3; rated 2 as the short linear flow limits the uncertainty.
probes/13 final.png shows white footer band ending mid-screen; purely visual. s=1.
Header/figure misalignment in tide table (root 1280); two time columns in time order are hard to confuse. s=1.
UTC tide times vs local arrival during BST; one-hour error against the gate window. s=3.
Boat errors 375 screenshot: Length border dark while siblings red, but red message sits directly above and summary lists it; error states only. s=1.
Detached unlabelled '...' holding Change dates; common need, search delay, learnable. s=2.
Booked thing named four ways across pages; every booking, brief doubt once. s=2.
Bare 'Booking stopped' dead end; blocks booking, recovery by phone. s=4.
Stranded '...' far right at 1280 hides Change dates; delay in a common subtask. s=2.
Tide header alignment; readable as seen in root 1280 screenshot. s=1.
One errored field per state keeps a dark border; message text and summary still identify it. s=1.
Same dead-end stop page (screenshot); no reason, no link back; blocks booking. s=4.
Isolated kebab draws the eye and hides Change dates; menu pushes list down; delay only. s=2.
Length/Arrival time keep default border in errors; red text above still flags them. s=1.
'Pontoon spaces' label over the wall berth; boats over 12 m (occasional) still see 'Wall berth 2, up to 15 metres' in the list. s=1.
